host.note: Every result below was run on this host or in the booted iOS simulator. A physical iPhone was not connected (devicectl reported it unavailable), so no device memory or termination evidence exists.

abi.feature: ios-vpn (off by default; desktop and Android builds do not compile or export it)
abi.drainFormat: [4-byte big-endian length][IP packet] records; buffer must hold max_count * (4 + 65535) bytes
abi.writeInput: drain record or a bare IP packet (an IP version nibble 4/6 is never treated as a length prefix)

selected.1: engine.json in the App Group selects rust
selected.-1: no engine.json (host never wrote its state); BillowRust reports code 10 hostNotReady

dataPlane.sharedIpcodec: outbound/ipstack (IPv4/IPv6 + UDP, also used by MASQUE CONNECT-IP; reusable by a desktop TUN in T6)
dataPlane.tcp: passive-open server endpoint (SYN-ACK with tunnel MSS, third ACK, data/ACK, half-close, RST); out-of-order data re-ACKed at RCV.NXT instead of buffered
dataPlane.udp: engine outbound UDP associations: DIRECT, ss, trojan, ssr, masque, shadowquic; other families refused by name and counted
dataPlane.routing: preHandleMetadata (hosts/fake-ip) -> rule -> proxy group -> DIRECT or dial_chain (dialer-proxy, proxy-server DNS); mirrors engine::serve_request/serve_udp_associate
dataPlane.inTypes: InType::Tun added; IN-TYPE,TUN loads and matches, connection registry kind 'Tun'
dataPlane.dns: UDP and TCP :53 hijack answered by the generation's DnsService::answer_query
dataPlane.rejections: IPv4 fragments and IPv6 extension headers refused by name; ICMP counted and dropped; unknown IPv4 protocol -> ICMP protocol unreachable; stray TCP -> RST; REJECT rule -> RST
dataPlane.reload: Kernel::reload; on success every TCP flow, UDP association, DIRECT socket and queued packet is released and generation increments; a rejected reload keeps the running generation

Host settings entry: BillowVPNManager/ResourcesInstaller exist and setSelected writes <AppGroup>/engine.json, but no Tauri ios_vpn_* command or TS entry calls them yet, so both extensions cannot be started from the app UI in this attempt.

Resource staging for the Rust engine: home/config.yaml must exist and must enable a listener (mixed-port/port/socks-port); the engine rejects a configuration without one. Geo assets must be staged next to config.yaml.
UDP for gost-relay, sudoku, tuic, hysteria*, mieru, wireguard, openvpn, tailscale, zerotier, easytier is not implemented in this kernel; the tunnel drops and counts those datagrams by name.
BillowMihomo extension build and the loopback (Rust -> mihomo) route were not part of this attempt.
The simulator smoke process peak RSS (~25-28 MB) is the smoke binary, not the extension; it is not R3 evidence.
